intro.en: A wish in the past uses the imperfect subjunctive.

bloques.titulo: The wish was in the past
bloques.texto:
Present wish: quiero que **vengas**.

Past wish: quería que **vinieras**.

Take the **ellos** form of the indefinido, drop **-ron**, add **-ra**: hablaron → habla**ra**, vinieron → vinie**ra**, pidieron → pidie**ra**.

Me **pidió que llamara**. The request was in the past, so the second verb is past too.

frases.en: I wanted you to come yesterday.
I wanted to come, but I worked.
frases.nota: Same person: infinitive, even in the past. Quería venir.

frases.en: I wanted you to speak with her.

pregunta.en: Complete: I wanted you to come.

vinieras.en: A past wish about tú uses the imperfect subjunctive.

vengas.en: Vengas is the present subjunctive: quiero que vengas.

pregunta.en: Complete: Ana asked me to call.

llamara.en: A past request takes the past subjunctive.

llame.en: Llame follows a present: me pide que llame.

pregunta.en: Complete, same person: I wanted to come.

que viniera.en: That would be about someone else.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write about what your parents and teachers wanted, asked or forbade you to do when you were a child.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Tell aloud about a job or a course in which you were asked to do things you did not expect.
